info.title: Common Foundry public chain data
info.description: A documented subset of public, read-only explorer endpoints. No registration or credentials are required. Responses describe an observed chain snapshot, not a promise of service availability or final settlement. Additional fields may be added.

get.summary: Read mainnet supply and burned fees at an observed chain tip

200.description: Supply values; CMFD quantities and atom counts are decimal strings. Circulating supply excludes the current steward and community balances. A permanent tail means max_supply is null.

429.description: Too many requests; honor Retry-After when present.

5XX.description: Data temporarily unavailable; back off and retry later.

get.summary: Read a bounded chain, peer, mempool, and recent activity snapshot

200.description: Live explorer JSON snapshot. Height and network fields should be checked before interpreting recent activity. This endpoint does not expose private wallet keys or perform writes.

429.description: Too many requests; honor Retry-After when present.

5XX.description: Data temporarily unavailable; back off and retry later.

CmfdAmount.description: CMFD amount with eight decimal places; use decimal arithmetic.

Atoms.description: Integer atoms as a string. One CMFD equals 100000000 atoms.
